features.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
features.desired_outcome: Display clear, non-intrusive instructional text overlays or narrative hints during the first few steps of the Moss Trail.
features.reason: First-time players need welcome tooltips at step 0 to understand initial movement and combat mechanics.

features.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
features.desired_outcome: An accessible in-game UI ledger displaying route completion tallies, collected unique items (like Gloomcaps or Moon Sigils), and reward milestones.
features.reason: Explorers and collectors desire an in-game tracking interface for unique route items and completion rewards.

features.title: Route-Specific Secret Chambers and Lore Collectibles
features.desired_outcome: Add optional secret branch paths or lore fragments into existing routes (such as Ember Forge or Gloomwood Hollow) that reward players with unique thematic cosmetics or codex entries upon discovery.
features.reason: As an explorer, once a route is finished, there are few gameplay reasons to replay it other than grinding standard currency.

features.title: Elite Combat Waves & Aggressive Enemy AI Profiles
features.desired_outcome: Introduce tougher elite enemy compositions and dynamic combat waves specifically for difficulty 3 routes like Frostfang Pass and Whispering Fen.
features.reason: Current high-difficulty routes rely primarily on environmental hazards rather than engaging, high-density combat pressure.

features.title: Daily Route Bounties for Bonus Currency
features.desired_outcome: Players can check a daily bounty board for rotating route objectives that award bonus coins upon completion.
features.reason: Helps bridge the gap between mid-tier cosmetics and elite items without breaking overall baseline game balance.

features.title: Expanded Keyboard Shortcut Mapping for HUD Actions
features.desired_outcome: Fully bindable keyboard shortcuts for movement, combat prompts, and marketplace toggles.
features.reason: Improves overall usability and accessibility compliance for navigation.

features.title: Input Buffering and Movement State Validation
features.desired_outcome: Engine-level input validation that suppresses invalid walk actions against active hazards or buffers jump transitions.
features.reason: Edge-case analysis confirms that players can spam walk commands into static barriers, taking multiple ticks of avoidable damage.

features.title: Elite Enemy Behavior Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.reason: Combat challengers reported low enemy encounter density and mechanical friction on high-tier routes.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States
features.reason: Accessibility council noted that marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.

features.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions.

policy.note: AI beta-test recommendations are advisory. The owner manually implements changes with ChatGPT and uses Development Review only to monitor status.
